text:
Ana (CS): Starting enrollment for the Meadow preview cohort — goal: 6-week trial, two onboarding sessions, weekly office hours, and lightweight feedback pulses wk1, wk3, wk6. Signup + logistics: https://redwood.in/forms/meadow-preview :seedling:

Derek - PM: metric asks: weekly_active_users target >= 30% seat-days, critical flow success >= 90%. if below week 4, trigger remediation playbook.

Hannah (Eng): telemetry events we'll need: `user.session`, `feature.call`, `latency.sample`, `feedback.submit` (store only hashed answers). sample curl for env: ```curl -X POST https://telemetry.redwood.internal/events -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"event":"feature.call","latency_ms":120}'```

Ana (CS): scheduling options for onboarding: Wed 9am PT, Thu 2pm PT. Marta from Meadow please pick. also we'll run an optional advanced deep-dive in week 2 for power users.

Marta (Customer): Thu 2pm works. can you shorten week-6 survey to 6 questions? our stakeholders prefer brief surveys.

Ana (CS): yes 96 we'll cut to 6 Qs focused on value, blockers, and likelihood to renew.

Derek - PM: for renewal signals, propose `engagement_index = 0.5*WAU_norm + 0.3*flow_success + 0.2*survey_nps`. CS ops, can you backfill WAU_norm for last preview cohort so we have a baseline?

Ana (CS): will queue a backfill. Hannah + infra-bot, what events are required?

Hannah (Eng): events: `user.session.start`, `user.session.end`, `api.call`, `survey.submit` (hashed). will push schema to staging by EOD and tag you.

infra-bot: infra task created: preview-meadow-tenants (6 seats). deploy hook pending.

Ana (CS): CS outreach cadence: welcome msg, day-2 checklist, week-2 usage nudge, week-4 readiness call invite, week-6 survey + wrap. templates to follow.

Marta (Customer): also can we have a dedicated Slack channel for quick bugs? that helps our engineers.

Hannah (Eng): we can auto-create #meadow-preview and add a webhook to create tickets in our tracker. infra-bot will provision.

infra-bot: channel #meadow-preview created (private). webhook configured for ticket sync.

Ana (CS): Marta pls DM attendee emails + indicate any EU users for residency routing. I'll confirm onboarding slot and share calendar invites.

Marta (Customer): sending list now. excited to start — thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
